During the last years of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]] and a large complement of [[Liberator-class starfighter|''Liberator''-class starfighters]] was sighted over the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]]-aligned agricultural world of [[Nez Peron/Legends|Nez Peron]], challenging the Sith Empire's authority. However, fighters from the elite [[Empire's Fury]] starfighter squadron soon arrived in system and engaged the Republic ships in the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] above of Nez Peron, in order to demonstrate the Empire's control over the region.<ref name="Nez Peron Sweep" />

The Empire's Fury fighters eliminated a large number of Republics starfighters and heavily damaged the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]], convincing their remaining forces to abandon the system.<ref name="Nez Peron Sweep" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle appears as the space combat mission "Nez Peron Sweep" for Imperial players in the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' and is part of [[Operation Eternal Domain]] together with [[Battle of Sarapin Four|Sarapin Assault]].
